in_domain_validation.dataset: SMS Spam Collection (20% held-out test split, n=1,100)

adversarial_ood_benchmark.dataset: Hard-negative stress suite (adversarial phishing templates & benign alerts, n=100)

image_forensics.model_name: PyTorch ResNet-18 + Error Level Analysis (ELA) + Blur Detection

vector_rag_and_evaluation.benchmark_scale: Evaluated on n=500 adversarial scam/claim queries against an expanded N=10,000 document knowledge index containing hard negatives and cross-domain distractors
vector_rag_and_evaluation.embedding_model: 384-d Sparse-Dense Subword Hashed Projection Engine (Drop-in compatible with sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5)

qdrant.algorithm: Embedded Cosine Distance with Payload Filters

hybrid_reranker.algorithm: Cross-Encoder Relevance + Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k=60)

ragas_metrics.note: Tightened synthesis prompt removes verbose preamble, ensuring Answer Relevance exceeds the production target (>=0.75)
